messages:
rachel: FYI: nightly SAST noisy spike for `payments-service` + CI shows KMS decrypt failures when scanner tries to fetch artifacts. Suspect RBAC change from infra rollout. Anyone oncall?

tom: Oof, saw the alert. Can you paste the CI log snippet and job id?

rachel: job=ci-scan/7129. Log:
```
2026-03-20T07:42:10Z ERROR downloader: fetch artifact payments/commit-9a1.tar.gz -> 403 KMS Decrypt failed for service-account-scan@redwood
2026-03-20T07:42:11Z INFO scanner: partial parse -> likely FP
```

amal: We pushed an updated scanner-helper IAM role yesterday to tighten perms. Looks like the new binding removed the CI SA from roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. I can confirm via `gcloud` in a sec.

security-bot: Alert created: SAST-nightly payments-service (ID 7129) - 38 findings (high:0 med:5). Tagging with `evidence:partial`. Link: https://sec.redwood/alerts/7129

nate: If artifacts are incomplete the ASTs are truncated and SAST rules trigger on uninitialized vars etc. We should avoid triaging those as real vulnerabilities.

tom: Agreed. Short-term: mark findings `pending-evidence` and queue a local scan (no remote fetch) to validate. Amal, can infra revert the role or re-add kms:Decrypt? Also add an audit log filter for artifact fetch errors.

amal: Opening infra PR to re-add binding now: infra#1288. Also adding a unit test to fail CI if `service-account-scan@redwood` is not listed in the cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter binding. Will add log sink for resource.type="artifact_bucket" severity>=ERROR.

infra-bot: infra#1288 created by amal - "re-add kms decrypt binding for scanner SA" assigned to infra-oncall. CI checks running.

rachel: Triage plan: 1) add `sast:pending-evidence` to current findings 2) run local SAST on top 10 PRs with `--no-remote` 3) once infra confirms role fix, re-run nightly and unmark findings that persist. Who wants ownership?

nate: I can run the local scans for the top 10. Will post diffs.

amal: Rolled back role change at 08:13 UTC (applied infra#1288). Re-run kickstarted. Also pushed an IAM integration test to infra CI.

tom: Thanks. If re-run still shows missing artifacts, escalate to oncall and open an incident. Otherwise we'll update the runbook to include a step: "on artifact 403 -> check KMS bindings + mark SAST findings as evidence-pending".

security-bot: CI re-run started (ci-scan/7130). Monitoring results.

rachel: Thanks all. Nate please link your local scan outputs and Ill coordinate PR labels. We'll close when nightly is green and real findings are validated.
